name: ai-for-product-management-pack
description: 31 Claude Skills for deciding what to build, what to drop and whether it worked: feature request triage, cost of delay, RICE and MoSCoW prioritisation, the Kano model, product vision and strategy, the north star metric, product OKRs and the now-next-later roadmap, customer interview guides and interview synthesis, jobs to be done, opportunity solution trees and assumption mapping, the working backwards PR/FAQ, prototype briefs, PRDs, story mapping and user stories, the product role charter, DACI decisions, the decision log and the pre-mortem, competitive analysis, the value proposition canvas, go-to-market plans and release notes, HEART success metrics, experiment design and the post-launch review.
